data.name: GF6B_001
data.value: The ruins end here. Something is blocking the path.

data.name: GF6B_002
data.value: It feels like the forest is holding its breath.

data.name: GF6B_003
data.value: Then we are close. Chenipent must have come this way.

data.name: GF6B_004
data.value: Wait... That was not a shadow.

data.name: GF6B_005
data.value: Something is standing between us and the heart of the forest.

data.name: GF6B_007
data.value: We are not leaving someone behind!

data.name: GF6B_008
data.value: We came this far together. We will finish this together.

data.name: GF6B_010
data.value: The forest will not forgive trespassers.

data.name: GF6B_011
data.value: The forest's gone quiet...[pause=20] Even the wind has stopped.

data.name: GF6B_012
data.value: So the little ones came all this way...

data.name: GF6B_013
data.value: The Guardian of the roots will not let you pass.

data.name: GF6B_R01
data.value: The tangle of roots has loosened.[pause=20] Daylight is getting through, right down to the ground.

data.name: GF6B_R02
data.value: (He let us walk in.[pause=15] Or he simply isn't watching anymore.)

data.name: GF6B_R03
data.value: The forest breathes better since he stopped standing guard over it.

data.name: GF6B_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
